_comment: Locators that are the same on every window (SharedElements). Name -> selector, or { selector, description }. Keys starting with _ are ignored. The same as agentic-qa-java's locators/common.json.

dropdownButton.description: the window's dropdown button (one per window: Add tool, Price Booking, Customer Window)

dropdownOption.description: option OPTION of the open dropdown: the li whose span shows OPTION
